name: Devnarayan Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
briefDescription: In Rajasthan, the Pre-Matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of Very Backward Class students.
descriptionMd: Extremely Backward Class Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme has been implemented on the lines of the pre-matric scholarship scheme being given to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students for classes 6th to 10th of very backward classes.
benefitsMd:
1. Selected students have to study according to the approved syllabus by State Government. 1. As per the rules Education, Accommodation, Meal, Dress, text writing material and books will be provided Free of cost.
**Category****Class****Scholarship Amount**Boy StudentsClass 6 to Class 8Rs. 50/- per monthGirl StudentsClass 6 to Class 8Rs. 100/- per monthBoy StudentsClass 9 to Class 10Rs. 60/- per monthGirl StudentsClass 9 to Class 10Rs. 120/- per month
eligibilityMd:
1. The students should be a native of Rajasthan state.
1. Applicant students should belong to the following Other Backward Classes, that must have been issued by Tehsildar or a higher-level revenue officer.
(i). Banjara, Baladiya, Labana. 
(ii). Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia.
(iii). Gujar, Gurjar. 
(iv). Raika, Raibari (Debasi).
(v). Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari.
1.  The annual income of the parents/guardian of the applicant from all sources (including the candidate's own income, if any) should be up to Rs.2,00,000 (Rupees two lakh). 
1. An employed student who studies as a full-time student by taking leave without pay during the entire course will be eligible for the scholarship.
1. All the children of the same parent/guardian will be eligible to benefit from this scheme.
1. Students who are not getting any kind of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources.
applicationMd:
1. Applicant students have to visit the [official website.](https://sjmsnew.rajasthan.gov.in/scholarship/)1. Now Select the Login option or Register Option. 
1. Applicants will be redirected to the [Rajasthan SSO portal](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register). 1. Now students can log in with their Jan-Aadhaar ID. 
1. Fill out the application form.
1. Attach the required documents.
1. Submit.
